high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from a presentation at the Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC). The slide is titled "The Big World Perspective: The world is much bigger and more complex than the agent." It features a graphic of a green globe with stick figures representing people around it, emphasizing the vastness and complexity of the world compared to an individual agent. On the right side of the image, there is a photograph of a man giving a presentation. He is standing behind a podium, holding a microphone in his right hand, and appears to be speaking.
